source: We should celebrate the progress without ignoring the remaining work.
target: Acknowledge the ground we have gained, but do not look away from what remains to be done.
references: Acknowledge the ground we have gained, but do not look away from what remains to be done.
source_meaning: We should celebrate the progress without ignoring the remaining work.

source: Trade-offs clear hone do. Phir decision ko support karunga.
target: Let the trade-offs be laid bare. Only then will I lend my support to the decision.
references: Let the trade-offs be laid bare. Only then will I lend my support to the decision.
source_meaning: I will support the decision once everyone understands the trade-offs.

source: Don't confuse being busy with making progress.
target: Activity can consume every hour yet yield nothing. Measure progress, not mere movement.
references: Activity can consume every hour yet yield nothing. Measure progress, not mere movement.
source_meaning: Don't confuse being busy with making progress.

source: Builder ko impress karna easy hai. User ke liye kaam karna real test hai.
target: Impressing the architects is trivial. The true test lies in serving those who must rely on it.
references: Impressing the architects is trivial. The true test lies in serving those who must rely on it.
source_meaning: I want a solution that works for the people using it, not just the people building it.

source: If we keep avoiding the hard conversation, nothing will change.
target: To evade the difficult dialogue is to preserve the burden. Nothing changes until we face it.
references: To evade the difficult dialogue is to preserve the burden. Nothing changes until we face it.
source_meaning: If we keep avoiding the hard conversation, nothing will change.

source: Agreement optional hai. Honesty mandatory.
target: Agreement is secondary. Absolute honesty is non-negotiable.
references: Agreement is secondary. Absolute honesty is non-negotiable.
source_meaning: I don't need you to agree with me; I need you to be honest with me.

source: We should fix the cause instead of repeatedly treating the symptoms.
target: Eradicate the root cause, not the surface symptoms. Continuous patchworks are no substitute for true resolution.
references: Eradicate the root cause, not the surface symptoms. Continuous patchworks are no substitute for true resolution.
source_meaning: We should fix the cause instead of repeatedly treating the symptoms.

source: Credit wahi lega jisne kaam kiya. Main kisi aur ka result claim nahi karta.
target: Credit belongs solely to the hand that labored. I will not claim another person’s result.
references: Credit belongs solely to the hand that labored. I will not claim another person’s result.
source_meaning: I will not take credit for work that someone else did.

source: The customer is confused because we gave them conflicting answers.
target: The customer is confused because our statements contradicted one another. We must speak with one consistent voice.
references: The customer is confused because our statements contradicted one another. We must speak with one consistent voice.
source_meaning: The customer is confused because we gave them conflicting answers.

source: Launch se pehle end-to-end test. Gaps baad mein mehange padte hain.
target: Subject the process to a rigorous test before launch. Flaws uncovered late exact a far greater toll.
references: Subject the process to a rigorous test before launch. Flaws uncovered late exact a far greater toll.
source_meaning: Before we launch, someone should test the process from beginning to end.

source: I will not reveal the plan before the signal arrives.
target: The plan remains sealed until the signal sounds. Not a moment sooner.
references: The plan remains sealed until the signal sounds. Not a moment sooner.
source_meaning: I will not reveal the plan before the signal arrives.

source: Doosri shipment pehle northern warehouse pahunchni chahiye.
target: The second shipment must reach the northern warehouse before all else.
references: The second shipment must reach the northern warehouse before all else.
source_meaning: The second shipment must reach the northern warehouse first.

source: We have enough fuel for the return journey, but not for a detour.
target: Our resources suffice for the return, but permit no detour. Stay within that boundary.
references: Our resources suffice for the return, but permit no detour. Stay within that boundary.
source_meaning: We have enough fuel for the return journey, but not for a detour.

source: Alarm do baar baje toh east exit se bahar nikalna.
target: Should the alarm sound twice, exit through the eastern gate.
references: Should the alarm sound twice, exit through the eastern gate.
source_meaning: If the alarm sounds twice, evacuate through the east exit.

source: The archive contains the original record, not the revised copy.
target: The archive holds the original record, not the revised copy. Do not mistake revision for truth.
references: The archive holds the original record, not the revised copy. Do not mistake revision for truth.
source_meaning: The archive contains the original record, not the revised copy.

source: Audit poora hone ke baad hi funds release karunga.
target: The funds will remain bound until the reckoning of the audit is complete.
references: The funds will remain bound until the reckoning of the audit is complete.
source_meaning: I will release the funds only after the audit is complete.

source: The north gate is guarded, while the west gate is unattended.
target: The northern gate stands guarded; the western gate remains exposed and unwatched.
references: The northern gate stands guarded; the western gate remains exposed and unwatched.
source_meaning: The north gate is guarded, while the west gate is unattended.

source: Night shift ke liye humein chhe volunteers chahiye.
target: Six must step forward to hold the night watch.
references: Six must step forward to hold the night watch.
source_meaning: We need six volunteers for the night shift.

source: The signal is weak inside the tunnel.
target: The signal falters within the passage. Never assume the link will endure.
references: The signal falters within the passage. Never assume the link will endure.
source_meaning: The signal is weak inside the tunnel.

source: Floor clear hone tak crates mat hilaana.
target: Do not move the cargo until the ground is completely cleared.
references: Do not move the cargo until the ground is completely cleared.
source_meaning: Do not move the crates until the floor is cleared.

source: The eastern route is longer, but it avoids the checkpoint.
target: The eastern path requires greater distance, yet bypasses surveillance. Weigh time against exposure.
references: The eastern path requires greater distance, yet bypasses surveillance. Weigh time against exposure.
source_meaning: The eastern route is longer, but it avoids the checkpoint.

source: Access card mere paas hai; code Mira ke paas hai.
target: I hold the access card; Mira possesses the code. Neither alone is sufficient.
references: I hold the access card; Mira possesses the code. Neither alone is sufficient.
source_meaning: I have the access card; Mira has the code.

source: The generator can run for three hours without refuelling.
target: The generator endures for three hours without refueling. Measure your time carefully.
references: The generator endures for three hours without refueling. Measure your time carefully.
source_meaning: The generator can run for three hours without refuelling.

source: Pehli koshish fail ho toh dobara try karne se pehle das seconds rukna.
target: Should the initial effort fail, pause for ten seconds before making a second attempt.
references: Should the initial effort fail, pause for ten seconds before making a second attempt.
source_meaning: If the first attempt fails, wait ten seconds before trying again.

source: The report lists four risks, but only two have mitigation plans.
target: The report documents four risks, yet only two carry mitigation plans. Two remain unmitigated.
references: The report documents four risks, yet only two carry mitigation plans. Two remain unmitigated.
source_meaning: The report lists four risks, but only two have mitigation plans.
